title: The Algorithm Chose This
style: dark electronic pop, 110 BPM, unsettling warm production, male vocal revealing the manipulation, slow build to confrontational chorus, data surveillance theme, attention economy critique, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
It noticed what you paused on
It noticed how long you stayed
It noticed the thing you almost clicked
And the decision that you delayed
It knows you better than your mother
It knows your political lean
It knows what makes you angry
And it serves you more of the same — mean

[CHORUS]
The algorithm chose this
You didn't ask — it knows
The algorithm chose this
From everything that flows
The algorithm chose this
And you kept on scrolling
The algorithm chose this
Because the cost is your time

[VERSE 2]
You could choose your own curriculum
One skill — one day — deliberate
Instead the feed is choosing
And the choice is infinite
Not curation — calculation
Not connection — extraction
PLUGGED asks what you actually want
The algorithm — just takes action

[BRIDGE]
You are not the user. You are the product. Until you choose differently.

[OUTRO]
Choose. Deliberately. Today.
